formula: h_d=HW(pad_{n_{i+1}}(d_i) XOR d_{i+1})/n_{i+1}; h_P=HW(SEC_compressed(P_i) XOR SEC_compressed(P_{i+1}))/264; S=SpearmanCorr(h_d,h_P); edge holdout (1,2)..(50,51) vs later; NO uncompressed/Pearson/factoradic/GLV/doubling
domains: edges consecutive by n; h_d,h_P in [0,1]
score_definition: Spearman correlation of adjacent Hamming rates
holdout_split: train edges through (50,51); test edges with n>=51; ranges n<=35 vs n>=36
trivial_exclusion_justification: Neighbor Hamming rates are not fixed by curve membership; permuting public order should destroy any real coupling.
